title: Wali bak binèh kruëng
intro: Bak saboh nanggroe dipat saboh dekrit tiran jiba seudeh keu le rumoh, saboh jiwa jiteurimong saboh peusan nyang jilawan mandum teumakot. Deungon haté njang peunoh deungon amanah, awaknjan djipeuphon saboh buët iman njang akan meu-ubah jalan saboh bansa. Bak ie nyang jiba barang nyang meuhareuga, harapan meujampu ngon arus.
clues: Ulôn udeb bak masa nyang teukeujot dan teumakot.
Lon teurimong ilham ilahi nyang geubri keberanian keu lon.
Ulôn geuyue bék teumakot atawa seudeh.
Lon peuduek aneuk lon lam saboh peti dan lon peuduk ateuh ie.
Aneuk lon diteumee le rumoh tangga penguasa, tapi aneuk lon yang laen di ikot.
Lon dipeusaboh lom ngon aneuk lon untuk lon susu, lagee nyang ka geujanjikan le Allah.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teu ilham keu ji rhom aneuk miet lam krueng .
trial.answer: Teu ilham keu ji rhom aneuk miet lam krueng .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh peti nyang geupeuduek lam krueng .
Saboh tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
location.answer: Saboh peti nyang geupeuduek lam krueng .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Aneuk nyan ka seulamat dipulang keu perawat .
Aneuk nyan gadoh keu siumu masa .
Aneuk nyan geuba u nanggroe jioh .
Aneuk nyan jeuet keu peunguasa sigra .
Aneuk nyan ji angkat le sidroe ureung meukat kaya .
outcome.answer: Aneuk nyan ka seulamat dipulang keu perawat .

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
